description: Source code for the InstallationNote class in ERPNext, handling installation note operations including validation, serial number checks, and status updates.

classes.name: InstallationNote
classes.description: A class representing an installation note, inheriting from TransactionBase, with methods for validation, serial number management, and status updates.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the InstallationNote object and setting up the status updater configuration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks including installation date and item table.

methods.name: is_serial_no_added
methods.description: Checks if a serial number is added when required and throws an error if not.

methods.name: is_serial_no_exist
methods.description: Verifies that serial numbers exist in the database.

methods.name: get_prevdoc_serial_no
methods.description: Retrieves serial numbers from the previous delivery note item.

methods.name: is_serial_no_match
methods.description: Checks if current serial numbers match those from the previous delivery note.

methods.name: validate_serial_no
methods.description: Validates serial numbers for all items in the installation note.

methods.name: validate_installation_date
methods.description: Ensures installation date is not before delivery date.

methods.name: check_item_table
methods.description: Checks if items are present in the installation note.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Sets the status to 'Draft' upon update.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Validates serial numbers, updates previous document status, and sets status to 'Submitted'.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Updates previous document status and sets status to 'Cancelled'.
